{{Top|leg}}
'''Quantum crystalline''' was a technology known by [[Doctor/Legends|Dr.]] [[Qwi Xux]]. She provided the [[Vor]]s with quantum crystalline technology so that they could use it in the construction of the new [[Cathedral of Winds/Legends|Cathedral of Winds]] as of [[11 ABY/Legends|11 ABY]]. It was also known to be used in [[Quantum-crystalline armor]].
